method: Rolling-origin model comparison with final holdout
evaluation: 5 expanding origins spaced 12 steps apart select the model on mean MAE; the final 12 observations are scored once and never used for selection; the selection is refitted on all history.
intervals: Combination(top3) produces no model intervals; empirical_q* columns are signed residual quantiles by horizon step from the 5 selection origins (5 residuals per step) and are descriptive.
interpretation: Combination(top3) had the lowest mean validation MAE (1.67); the runner-up was Airline ARIMA (1.68). Final-holdout MAE for the selection: 1.62. Compare against Seasonal naive before trusting the gain.
